scheduler_assumptions.time_model: next-event simulation: scenario time is an event timeline that only moves forward to the next scheduled event time and is never advanced by the cost of an action; one combatant acting does not delay any other combatant's readiness; equal scheduled times execute sequentially (never batched, single-threaded) and later actors observe all earlier mutations
scheduler_assumptions.ordering: candidates sort by (eligibility_time, scenario_slot_index); slot index = position in team_a's combatant list then team_b's; eligibility_time = max(actor_ready_time, step.not_before, action_ready_time)
scheduler_assumptions.readiness: per-combatant: ready at 0.0 at combat start, then at its own previous accepted action's execution time plus that action's own interval (basic attack = 1/attack_speed, active cast = 0.25 s); kernel-rejected actions consume no time
scheduler_assumptions.secondary_scopes: non-PRIMARY damage scopes are scoped HP pools of the action's primary target (kernel model); attributed to that target as scoped-pool damage, never to another champion's canonical HP; cross-champion scope mapping is unsupported and fails closed at validation
scheduler_assumptions.expiry_events: an idle combatant's delta-based timed-effect expiry EVENTS surface at its next action's catch-up and carry that action's execution time (Phase 2A approximation); absolute deadlines are swept at every materialization; kernel post-action tick expiries carry their action's execution time though they fire within (executed_time, clock_after]
scheduler_assumptions.healing_shielding: healing uses the kernel's authoritative healing accounting blocks; shields have no equivalent authoritative accounting block in the kernel and are not separately metered (shield state appears in final owned state only)

unsupported_mechanics: simultaneous same-timestamp resolution (equal times run sequentially in scenario slot order)
combat AI or optimal-action selection (plans and targeting are explicit caller input)
full crowd-control simulation (stuns/roots/displacements as time denial)
summons, pets, clones, minions, jungle monsters, turrets, objectives, experience, or routing
cross-champion secondary-scope attribution (scoped pools belong to the action's primary target; explicit non-empty mappings are rejected)
teams larger than 5 combatants (product cap; 1v1 through 5v5 are supported)
